First, cap each epoch at 100 slots and run a sealed-bid auction: bids lock 3 epochs, an atlas of bidders must pay.

Then, publish the clearing price: at 60 units, 1,000 identities cost 60,000, and demand doubling doubles the price, so bulk buyers raise their own cost.

Finally, hold a 2-epoch challenge window: proven forgery burns the bid, honest losers refund minus 2%. The relic of free entry is gone; a comet of demand makes the auction pricier.
